EditTextPreference.android:summary: Shown instead of your wallet address and device addresses in every log, trace and screen. Stored only on this phone.

MultiSelectListPreference.android:title: Never exit through
MultiSelectListPreference.android:summary: Countries whose relays must not be your exit. Tap to choose from the relays currently known.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Bridge lines
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Only if the built-in entries are blocked where you are: paste bridge lines handed to you privately, one per row.

Preference.android:title: Back up wallet
Preference.android:summary: Show the seed that holds your balance. Write it down: uninstalling this app deletes it, and no server keeps a copy.

Preference.android:title: Restore wallet
Preference.android:summary: Put back a wallet from a seed you saved. The wallet on this phone is kept, not deleted.
